info.title: Veðurvaki API
info.description: Weather, road and operational risk for outdoor activities in Iceland, plus the data feeds that keep it accurate. Decision support only: a person makes the final safety decision.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Create keys in Admin → Partners & API. Scopes: read, ingest, tours, webhooks.

Activity.description: snowmobile, glacier hike, ice cave, snorkelling, northern lights, whale watching, super jeep, rafting, ATV

Limits.description: [risk starts, usually cancelled] per factor. g gust m/s, p rain mm/h, c cloud %, s waves m, t °C

marine.description: offshore point for wave data (boat activities)

sourceSpread.description: max − min gust between forecast models (m/s)

observation.description: nearest station reading (IMO / Vegagerðin) within 40 km

get.summary: Hourly conditions for any point in Iceland
get.description: Fused forecast from several weather models at the exact point, nearest station observation and nearby cameras.

post.summary: Risk that an activity is cancelled
post.description: Either an activity at any point and time (activity defaults or your own limits), or a configured tour and departure (uses learned thresholds and linked roads).

get.summary: Upcoming departures of configured tours, sorted by risk

put.summary: Create or update tours (upsert by id)

post.summary: Add or update guests (upsert by ref + departure)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same key to safely retry a POST; the first response is replayed for 24 h.

post.summary: Seats taken per departure (latest snapshot wins)

post.summary: Subscribe to events (https only). The response contains the signing secret once.

post.description: Verify X-Vedurvaki-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")). Reject if |now − t| > 300 s. Answer 2xx within 10 s; retries follow after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 6 h.
